parameters.help_en:
The specific topic to which the rule is applied. The format is typically `${deviceName}/topicShortName`. In this format, `${deviceName}` is the device name, and `topicShortName` is the short name of the topic.

For a basic communication topic or a Thing Specification Language model communication topic, the short topic format is typically `${deviceName}/topicShortName`. In this format, you can use the wildcard `+` instead of `${deviceName}` to represent all device names under the product. Valid values of `topicShortName`:

    - `/thing/event/property/post`: property messages submitted by devices.
    - `/thing/event/${tsl.event.identifier}/post`: event messages submitted by devices. `${}` represents the event identifier in the Thing Specification Language model of the product.
    - `/thing/lifecycle`: device lifecycle change messages.
    - `/thing/downlink/reply/message`: result messages of device responses to cloud instructions.
    - `/thing/list/found`: messages submitted by gateways to report discovered sub-devices.
    - `/thing/topo/lifecycle`: device topology change messages.
    - `/thing/event/property/history/post`: historical property messages submitted by devices.
    - `/thing/event/${tsl.event.identifier}/history/post`: historical event messages submitted by devices. `${}` represents the event identifier in the Thing Specification Language model of the product.
    - `/ota/upgrade`: OTA upgrade status notification messages for devices.
    - `/ota/version/post`: OTA module version number reporting messages submitted by devices.
    - `/thing/deviceinfo/update`: device tag change messages.
    - `/edge/driver/${driver_id}/point_post`: pass-through pattern topic messages for Link IoT Edge. `${}` represents the device access driver ID for Link IoT Edge.

 The OTA upgrade batch status notification topic is also a basic communication topic. The short topic format is `${packageId}/${jobId}/ota/job/status`. In this format, `${packageId}` is the upgrade package ID, and `${jobId}` is the upgrade batch ID.
For a custom topic, the short topic format is like `${deviceName}/user/get`.

  You can invoke the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/69647.html operation to view all custom topic categories under the product.

    When you specify a custom topic, you can use the wildcards `+` and `#`.
    - You can use the wildcard `+` instead of `${deviceName}` to represent all devices under the product.
    - You can use `/user/#` for subsequent fields. `#` represents all hierarchy levels after the `/user` level.
    For more information about how to use wildcards, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/85539.html.
For a device status change notification topic, the short topic format is `${deviceName}`.

 You can directly use the wildcard `+` to represent status change notifications for all devices under the product
parameters.help_zh:
应用该规则的具体Topic，格式一般为：`${deviceName}/topicShortName`。其中，`${deviceName}`是具体设备的名称，`topicShortName`是Topic短名称。

基础通信Topic或物模型通信Topic的ShortTopic，格式一般为：`${deviceName}/topicShortName`。其中，`${deviceName}`可以使用通配符`+`代替，表示产品下所有设备名称。`topicShortName`取值如下：

    - `/thing/event/property/post `设备上报的属性消息。
    - `/thing/event/${tsl.event.identifier}/post`设备上报的事件消息，`${}`中是产品物模型中事件identifier。
    - `/thing/lifecycle` 设备生命周期变更消息。
    - `/thing/downlink/reply/message`设备响应云端指令的结果消息。
    - `/thing/list/found`网关上报发现子设备消息。
    - `/thing/topo/lifecycle`设备拓扑关系变更消息。
    - `/thing/event/property/history/post`设备历史属性上报消息。
    - `/thing/event/${tsl.event.identifier}/history/post`设备历史事件上报消息，`${}`中是产品物模型中事件identifier。
    - `/ota/upgrade`设备OTA升级状态通知消息。
    - `/ota/version/post`设备OTA模块版本号上报消息。
    - `/thing/deviceinfo/update`设备标签变更消息。
    - `/edge/driver/${driver_id}/point_post`物联网边缘计算的透传模式Topic消息，`${}`中是物联网边缘计算的设备接入驱动ID。

 OTA升级批次状态通知Topic也属于基础通信Topic，ShortTopic格式为：`${packageId}/${jobId}/ota/job/status`。其中，`${packageId}`是升级包ID，`${jobId}`是升级批次ID。
自定义Topic的ShortTopic，如：`${deviceName}/user/get`。

  调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/69647.html接口，可以查看产品下的所有自定义Topic类。

    指定自定义Topic时，可以使用通配符`+`和`#`。
    - `${deviceName}`可以使用通配符`+`代替，表示产品下所有设备；
    - 之后字段可以用`/user/#`，`#`表示`/user`层级之后的所有层级名称。
    使用通配符，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/85539.html。
设备状态变化通知Topic的ShortTopic：`${deviceName}`。

 可以直接使用通配符`+`，表示产品下所有设备的状态变化通知

parameters.help_en: The name of the rule. The name must be 1 to 30 characters in length, and can contain Chinese characters, English letters, Japanese characters, digits, underscores (_), and hyphens (-). A Chinese or Japanese character counts as two characters
parameters.help_zh: 规则名称。支持中文、英文字母、日文、数字、下划线（_）和短划线（-），长度为1~30个字符，一个中文或日文占2个字符
parameters.name: name

parameters.help_zh: 规则的描述信息。长度限制为100个字符，一个中文字符计为1个字符
parameters.name: rule_desc

parameters.help_en:
The data format processed by the rule. The format must be the same as the device data to be processed. Valid values:

JSON (default): JSON data.
BINARY: binary data.

If you select BINARY, you cannot set TopicType to 0 (basic communication topic or Thing Specification Language model communication topic). In addition, data forwarding to <props="china"><ph>time series data storage in the instance, Time Series Database (TSDB), </ph></props>Tablestore, and ApsaraDB RDS is not supported
parameters.help_zh:
规则处理的数据格式，需与待处理的设备数据格式一致。取值：

JSON（默认）：JSON数据。
BINARY：二进制数据。

若选择为BINARY，TopicType不能选择为0（基础通信Topic或物模型通信Topic），且不支持将数据转发至<props="china"><ph>实例内的时序数据存储、时序数据库、</ph></props>表格存储和云数据库RDS版
parameters.name: data_type

parameters.help_en:
0: the basic communication topic or Thing Specification Language model communication topic described in the ShortTopic parameter, including the OTA upgrade batch status notification topic.
1: custom topic.
2: device status change notification topic: `/as/mqtt/status/${productKey}/${deviceName}`
parameters.help_zh:
0：ShortTopic参数描述中的基础通信Topic或物模型通信Topic，包含OTA升级批次状态通知Topic。
1：自定义Topic。
2：设备状态变化通知Topic：`/as/mqtt/status/${productKey}/${deviceName}`
